title: China AI update (2026) - DeepSeek V4 on Huawei silicon, compute substitution, and training closure
source: Public record: DeepSeek V4 (2026) optimized to run EXCLUSIVELY on Huawei Ascend (950/910D), a departure from the Nvidia-H800-trained earlier models; ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent ordered hundreds of thousands of Ascend chips after V4; first frontier-scale validation of Ascend. Huawei now ~50-60% of China's AI-chip market (Nvidia's China share fell from ~95% in 2023 to ~8% in 2026); Huawei planned ~750k Ascend 950PR units in 2026 (mass production from Apr). Constraints: node stuck at 7nm, reliance on stockpiled foreign HBM. Biren + Moore Threads also advancing; Alibaba T-Head + Baidu Kunlun ship CUDA-compatible parts. NIST CAISI: DeepSeek V4 Pro ~8 months behind frontier (May 2026); GLM-5.2 ~comparable to a US model ~6 months older (Opus 4.6, Jul 2026). US policy fluid: H200 exports moved to case-by-case (Jan 2026, 9 certifications); BIS treats Huawei-Ascend use anywhere as a presumptive EAR violation. NEW: Beijing deliberating restricting overseas access to leading Chinese models incl. open-weight Qwen (Jul 2026); drift toward closed-source ('training closure'); China certified 9 domestic AI processors for government procurement. Overlay on the existing China-AI threads; structural edges only. HONESTY: releases/market-share/policy actions/benchmarks = fact (with attributor cited); R2 (fully-domestic training) is the UNRESOLVED test; capability-gap figures are the named evaluators' assessments, not settled truth.

edges.notes: DeepSeek V4 (2026) was optimized to run EXCLUSIVELY on Huawei Ascend (950/910D) - a sharp break from its Nvidia-H800-trained earlier models and the first frontier-scale endorsement of Ascend. R2 (if trained fully on domestic silicon) would prove frontier models can be built without Nvidia; if it needs Nvidia, the dependency narrative persists (fact of V4; R2 = unresolved).
ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent ordered hundreds of thousands of Ascend chips after the V4 launch - the demand scramble that validated Huawei at scale (fact).

Huawei now ~50-60% of China's AI-chip market (from ~nothing 3 years ago); planned ~750k Ascend 950PR in 2026. Limits: stuck at 7nm, dependent on stockpiled foreign HBM. The 910D is now the backbone of Chinese data centers (fact of share + constraints).

Nvidia's China AI-chip share collapsed from ~95% (2023) to ~8% (2026) under export controls - 'a policy meant to slow China's buildout minted its chip champion' (fact; the irony is the cited analysts' framing).

US BIS moved H200-class exports to China to case-by-case review (Jan 2026) with 9 certifications incl. a cap tied to US shipments + a no-weight-transfer commitment; USTR said no H200 deliveries had occurred despite clearances - controls remain a live but fluid constraint (fact).

BIS guidance treats USE of certain Huawei Ascend chips ANYWHERE in the world as a presumptive EAR violation, and extends license requirements to entities with Chinese ultimate parents wherever located (May 2026) - escalation aimed squarely at Ascend (fact).
Alibaba's Qwen team (like DeepSeek + Moonshot) re-tooled training/inference to run on a mix of stockpiled Nvidia A100/H800 + domestic chips - the frontier labs adapting to the silicon shift (fact).

TRAINING CLOSURE: Beijing began deliberations (Jul 2026) on restricting overseas access to leading Chinese models including open-weight Qwen, and Chinese labs are drifting to closed-source - the open-weight era that made Qwen/DeepSeek globally popular may be closing from the state side (fact of the deliberations; outcome unresolved).

Capability gap (named evaluators, not settled truth): NIST CAISI judged DeepSeek V4 Pro ~8 months behind the frontier (May 2026) and GLM-5.2 ~comparable to a US model ~6 months older (Opus 4.6, Jul 2026) - closing but not closed (fact of the assessments; absolute gap contested).

Beijing's coherent 2026 strategy = 'total compute substitution' (domestic silicon end-to-end) + 'training closure' (closed ecosystems), backed by government certification of 9 domestic AI processors for state procurement - indigenization + control as one program (interpretation of the strategy; the certifications + substitution = fact).
